records.context: Voyager3: give each OPS gene cluster a biological role, from fetched UniProt facts, through the user's own AI.
records.label: spacr.voyager3#0
records.source: Voyager3: give each OPS gene cluster a biological role, from fetched UniProt facts, through the user's own AI.
records.translation: Voyager3: atribui a cada cluster de genes do OPS um papel biológico, a partir de fatos obtidos do UniProt, por meio da IA do próprio usuário.

records.context: The last step of the OPS profile path (item 973, alpha). For every gene of every cluster, :func:`fetch_gene_facts` fetches the reviewed UniProt entry (protein names, function, GO process / component / function, pathway, subcellular location and the annotation score) through :mod:`spacr.uniprot`, whose cache makes a rerun offline. :func:`build_cluster_prompt` writes one English prompt per cluster with those facts, the cluster's statistics and the screening experiment context; the template is not translated. The prompt goes to the AI provider the user chose under Preferences, spaCR AI (free) or a vendor command-line tool signed in with the user's own account; nothing here uses a vendor API, an API structured-data name or a batch service. The report and the provenance name the provider and model, and say when the free provider answered with its smaller model. :func:`parse_cluster_answer` reads the structured answer (role, confidence, supporting genes, genes that do not fit, uncharacterised candidates with suggested roles) and never throws on a malformed one.
records.label: spacr.voyager3#1
records.source: The last step of the OPS profile path (item 973, alpha). For every gene of every cluster, :func:`fetch_gene_facts` fetches the reviewed UniProt entry (protein names, function, GO process / component / function, pathway, subcellular location and the annotation score) through :mod:`spacr.uniprot`, whose cache makes a rerun offline. :func:`build_cluster_prompt` writes one English prompt per cluster with those facts, the cluster's statistics and the screen context; the template is not translated. The prompt goes to the AI provider the user chose under Preferences, spaCR AI (free) or a vendor command-line tool signed in with the user's own account; nothing here uses a vendor API, an API key or a batch service. The report and the provenance name the provider and model, and say when the free provider answered with its smaller model. :func:`parse_cluster_answer` reads the structured answer (role, confidence, supporting genes, genes that do not fit, uncharacterised candidates with suggested roles) and never raises on a malformed one.
records.translation: A última etapa do caminho de perfil do OPS (item 973, alfa). Para cada gene de cada cluster, :func:`fetch_gene_facts` obtém a entrada revisada do UniProt (nomes da proteína, função, processo / componente / função GO, via, localização subcelular e o escore de anotação) por meio de :mod:`spacr.uniprot`, cujo cache permite repetir a execução offline. :func:`build_cluster_prompt` escreve um prompt em inglês por cluster com esses fatos, as estatísticas do cluster e o contexto da triagem; o modelo de texto não é traduzido. O prompt vai para o provedor de IA que o usuário escolheu em Preferências, o spaCR AI (gratuito) ou uma ferramenta de linha de comando de um fornecedor autenticada com a conta do próprio usuário; nada aqui usa uma API de fornecedor, uma chave de API ou um serviço em lote. O relatório e a proveniência indicam o provedor e o modelo, e informam quando o provedor gratuito respondeu com seu modelo menor. :func:`parse_cluster_answer` lê a resposta estruturada (papel, confiança, genes de suporte, genes que não se encaixam, candidatos não caracterizados com papéis sugeridos) e nunca gera exceção diante de uma resposta malformada.

records.context: The confidence is also computed by spaCR from the share of the cluster's genes the answer cites as support (above 70 % high, 50-70 % medium, 30-50 % low, below that none, the thresholds of Brieflow's MozzareLLM), so a stated confidence that the cited genes do not bear out is visible. Gene names that are not in the cluster are dropped and counted.
records.label: spacr.voyager3#2
records.source: The confidence is also computed by spaCR from the share of the cluster's genes the answer cites as support (above 70 % high, 50-70 % medium, 30-50 % low, below that none, the thresholds of Brieflow's MozzareLLM), so a stated confidence that the cited genes do not bear out is visible. Gene names that are not in the cluster are dropped and counted.
records.translation: A confiança também é calculada pelo spaCR a partir da fração dos genes do cluster que a resposta cita como suporte (acima de 70 % high, 50-70 % medium, 30-50 % low, abaixo disso none, os limiares do MozzareLLM do Brieflow), de modo que uma confiança declarada que os genes citados não sustentam fica visível. Nomes de genes que não estão no cluster são descartados e contados.

records.context: Every processing session writes ``voyager3_provenance.json``: the system text, every prompt, the template version, the provider and model, the UniProt release and fetch date, the facts each prompt used and every raw answer. :func:`voyager3_replay` writes the tables again from that file alone, and :func:`run_voyager3` writes its own tables through the same code, so the two are byte-identical.
records.label: spacr.voyager3#3
records.source: Every run writes ``voyager3_provenance.json``: the system text, every prompt, the template version, the provider and model, the UniProt release and fetch date, the facts each prompt used and every raw answer. :func:`voyager3_replay` writes the tables again from that file alone, and :func:`run_voyager3` writes its own tables through the same code, so the two are byte-identical.
records.translation: Toda execução grava ``voyager3_provenance.json``: o texto de sistema, cada prompt, a versão do modelo de texto, o provedor e o modelo, a versão e a data de obtenção do UniProt, os fatos que cada prompt usou e cada resposta bruta. :func:`voyager3_replay` grava as tabelas novamente apenas a partir desse arquivo, e :func:`run_voyager3` grava suas próprias tabelas pelo mesmo código, de modo que os dois resultados são idênticos byte a byte.

records.source: The prompt names the template version, the cluster and its size, its statistics, the screen context and the UniProt release, then one block of facts per gene in sorted order, the tasks (with MozzareLLM's 70 / 50 / 30 % confidence rule) and the JSON answer schema. A prompt longer than :data:`PROMPT_BUDGET` characters is written again with shorter facts (function cut to 200 characters, 4 GO process terms, no GO component or function terms), and says so. records.translation: O prompt indica a versão do modelo de texto, o cluster e seu tamanho, suas estatísticas, o contexto da triagem e a versão do UniProt, depois um bloco de fatos por gene em ordem alfabética, as tarefas (com a regra de confiança de 70 / 50 / 30 % do MozzareLLM) e o esquema JSON da resposta. records.context: Read one Voyager3 answer into checked fields; never throws.
records.label: spacr.voyager3.parse_cluster_answer#0
records.source: Read one Voyager3 answer into checked fields; never raises.
records.translation: Lê uma resposta do Voyager3 em campos verificados; nunca gera exceção.

records.context: The JSON is the first ``json`` fence, else the first balanced object; an object with none of the answer microscope fields of view (such as one gene entry of a cut-off answer) counts as unparsed. Gene names are matched to the cluster without regard to case; names that are not members are dropped into ``unknown_genes``. A priority that is not a whole number from 1 to 10 becomes None. ``support_fraction`` is the share of the cluster's genes given as support, and ``confidence_rule`` its confidence word: above 0.7 ``high``, 0.5 to 0.7 ``medium``, 0.3 to 0.5 ``low``, below 0.3 ``none``.
records.label: spacr.voyager3.parse_cluster_answer#1
records.source: The JSON is the first ``json`` fence, else the first balanced object; an object with none of the answer fields (such as one gene entry of a cut-off answer) counts as unparsed. Gene names are matched to the cluster without regard to case; names that are not members are dropped into ``unknown_genes``. A priority that is not a whole number from 1 to 10 becomes None. ``support_fraction`` is the share of the cluster's genes given as support, and ``confidence_rule`` its confidence word: above 0.7 ``high``, 0.5 to 0.7 ``medium``, 0.3 to 0.5 ``low``, below 0.3 ``none``.
records.translation: O JSON é o primeiro bloco cercado ``json``, ou então o primeiro objeto balanceado; um objeto sem nenhum dos campos da resposta (como a entrada de um gene de uma resposta cortada) conta como não analisado. Os nomes dos genes são comparados com o cluster sem diferenciar maiúsculas e minúsculas; nomes que não são membros vão para ``unknown_genes``. Uma prioridade que não seja um número inteiro de 1 a 10 torna-se None. ``support_fraction`` é a fração dos genes do cluster indicados como suporte, e ``confidence_rule`` sua palavra de confiança: acima de 0.7 ``high``, de 0.5 a 0.7 ``medium``, de 0.3 a 0.5 ``low``, abaixo de 0.3 ``none``.

records.context: Reads the clusters (``ops_voyager3_clusters``), fetches their genes' UniProt facts (:func:`fetch_gene_facts`, cached in ``uniprot_cache`` beside the outputs), asks the provider once per cluster (one retry after an error or an empty answer) and writes the outputs through :func:`voyager3_replay`'s code. With ``ops_voyager3_shuffle_control`` the same is done for a seeded shuffle of the genes across the clusters, sizes kept. Prints a ``Progress: n/total, operation_type: Voyager3`` line per cluster, with the counts of answers replayed and asked.
records.label: spacr.voyager3.run_voyager3#1
records.source: Reads the clusters (``ops_voyager3_clusters``), fetches their genes' UniProt facts (:func:`fetch_gene_facts`, cached in ``uniprot_cache`` beside the outputs), asks the provider once per cluster (one retry after an error or an empty answer) and writes the outputs through :func:`voyager3_replay`'s code. With ``ops_voyager3_shuffle_control`` the same is done for a seeded shuffle of the genes across the clusters, sizes kept. Prints a ``Progress: n/total, operation_type: Voyager3`` line per cluster, with the counts of answers replayed and asked.
records.translation: Lê os clusters (``ops_voyager3_clusters``), obtém os fatos do UniProt de seus genes (:func:`fetch_gene_facts`, em cache em ``uniprot_cache`` ao lado das saídas), consulta o provedor uma vez por cluster (uma nova tentativa após um erro ou uma resposta vazia) e grava as saídas pelo código de :func:`voyager3_replay`. Com ``ops_voyager3_shuffle_control``, o mesmo é feito para um embaralhamento com semente dos genes entre os clusters, mantendo os tamanhos. Imprime uma linha ``Progress: n/total, operation_type: Voyager3`` por cluster, com as contagens de respostas reutilizadas e consultadas.

records.context: Each answer is saved as it arrives, in ``ops_voyager3_answers_dir`` (``answers`` beside the outputs when empty), as one JSON file named by the SHA-256 of the template version, model, system text and prompt, holding the raw text, the model ids and cost the provider reported, and the seconds taken; the file is written to a temporary name and renamed. With ``ops_voyager3_resume`` on (the default) a rerun replays the saved answer of every prompt it finds and asks only the others, so an interrupted run picks up where it stopped and writes the same tables; a changed model, template or prompt asks again. Failed and timed-out calls are not saved. The provenance records which answers were replayed and which were asked.

records.source: Each answer is saved as it arrives, in ``ops_voyager3_answers_dir`` (``answers`` beside the outputs when empty), as one JSON file named by the SHA-256 of the template version, model, system text and prompt, holding the raw text, the model ids and cost the provider reported, and the seconds taken; the file is written to a temporary name and renamed. With ``ops_voyager3_resume`` on (the default) a rerun replays the saved answer of every prompt it finds and asks only the others, so an interrupted run picks up where it stopped and writes the same tables; a changed model, template or prompt asks again. Failed and timed-out calls are not saved. The provenance records which answers were replayed and which were asked.
records.translation: Cada resposta é salva assim que chega, em ``ops_voyager3_answers_dir`` (``answers`` ao lado das saídas quando vazio), como um arquivo JSON nomeado pelo SHA-256 da versão do modelo de texto, do modelo, do texto de sistema e do prompt, contendo o texto bruto, os ids de modelo e o custo informados pelo provedor e os segundos gastos; o arquivo é gravado com um nome temporário e depois renomeado. Com ``ops_voyager3_resume`` ativado (o padrão), uma nova execução reutiliza a resposta salva de cada prompt que encontra e consulta apenas os demais, de modo que uma execução interrompida continua de onde parou e grava as mesmas tabelas; uma mudança de modelo, de modelo de texto ou de prompt leva a uma nova consulta. Chamadas que falharam ou excederam o tempo limite não são salvas. A proveniência registra quais respostas foram reutilizadas e quais foram consultadas.
